shots.description: Cover: Level 1 mid-heist — the thief crouched behind the King Statue as a guard's vision cone sweeps past, one artefact already pocketed (LOOT 1/3), alarm at 35, the remaining loot and the green EXIT visible.
Title screen: Shadow Vault, the night museum, how to play (WASD/arrows, Shift sneak, E pocket loot, R restart), press ENTER to slip inside.
Level 2 mid-game — the thief hidden in a shadow patch with two artefacts pocketed (LOOT 2/4), two guard vision cones crossing the Hall of Relics ahead.
Win screen: VANISHED — every artefact stolen, final score and total time, ghost bonuses earned.
